desc: Prove the feasibility characterization for \(k\) pairs using sorted bottom and top mochi.
Reduce the aligned inequalities to \(k+\max_{x\in[L,L+k-1]}(p[x]-x)\le R-L+1\).
Compute \(p[x]\) with a monotone two-pointer scan and support range maxima with a sparse table.
Binary-search each query answer, including duplicates, odd lengths, and impossible-pair cases.
Provide the final Python solution with fast input/output and verify both public samples.
